content.title: CSV Q3 Deep Dive: Cemetery Strength and Tech Investments Offset Funeral Volume Weakness
content.summary: Funeral services company Carriage Services (NYSE:CSV) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 2% year on year to $102.7 million.
